2.title: FP&A Manager, Supply Chain & Revenue
2.excerpt: You will have full ownership of revenue forecasting, sales pipeline auditing, COGS forecasting, wafer economics, yield optimization, and R&D compute infrastructure…

3.title: Sr. Sales Operations Specialist
3.excerpt: Own the forecasting process and cadence, including weekly pipeline reviews, monthly and quarterly forecast calls, and board-level revenue reporting.

4.title: Senior Digital & AI Marketing Expert
4.excerpt: Manage paid search and HubSpot email programs, and keep our contact database up-to-date and compliant.

5.title: Data & AI Platform, Intern - Summer 2027
5.excerpt: This team is Lightmatter's Central Data Platform, the Snowflake foundation that engineering, product, and analytics teams across the company build on.

6.title: FP&A Manager, Supply Chain & Revenue
6.excerpt: Familiarity with enterprise ERP, CRM, and FP&A tools (e.g., Salesforce, NetSuite, Anaplan, Pigment, Workday Adaptive).
